keyPhrases.text: Mr. Clooney certainly captures the look and essence of the infamous Edward R. Murrow
The impressive scenic design By Scott Pask captures the period detail
only keeps a slow steady and monotonous pace that makes the production drag
add nothing to the advancement of the plot and almost seem intrusive
they cannot overcome the two-dimensional characters
the product lacks the substance and dramatic punch that makes live theatre exciting
if you are willing to gamble and make that hefty investment for a ticket

reasoning: While the review acknowledges some strong technical elements (design, Clooney's performance), it delivers significant criticism of pacing, character development, and overall theatrical impact. The closing line about 'gambling' on expensive tickets suggests a qualified negative recommendation.
